spec_theorems.name: cutLine_is_closed_range
spec_theorems.informal: For a requested closed character range A-B, each output line is exactly the characters obtained by dropping the first A-1 input characters and taking at most B-A+1 characters.

spec_theorems.name: selected_length_le_range_width
spec_theorems.informal: The selected character sequence from any input line is never longer than the requested closed range width.

spec_theorems.name: selected_empty_when_short
spec_theorems.informal: If an input line has fewer than A characters, selecting range A-B yields no characters for that line.

spec_theorems.name: run_valid_stdout
spec_theorems.informal: For valid -c A-B arguments, stdout consists of applying the per-line character cut to every stdin line.

spec_theorems.name: run_valid_exit
spec_theorems.informal: For valid -c A-B arguments, the utility exits successfully with status 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_valid_line_count
spec_theorems.informal: For valid -c A-B arguments, the number of output lines equals the number of input lines.
